'''Celegian life support chambers''' were devices that allowed members of the [[Celegian/Legends|Celegian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to survive off of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Celegia]]. The chambers cost 6,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed 50 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
